parameters.text:
={{ "Analyze the sentiment and reputation for these three brands based on their news coverage. For each brand, provide a reputation score from 1-10 (where 10 is excellent reputation) and a brief sentiment analysis.

Brand 1: " + $json.brands[0].name + "
Mentions: " + $json.brands[0].mentions + "
News text: " + $json.brands[0].text.substring(0, 3000) + "

Brand 2: " + $json.brands[1].name + "
Mentions: " + $json.brands[1].mentions + "
News text: " + $json.brands[1].text.substring(0, 3000) + "

Brand 3: " + $json.brands[2].name + "
Mentions: " + $json.brands[2].mentions + "
News text: " + $json.brands[2].text.substring(0, 3000) + "

Provide your response in this exact JSON format:
{
  "brands": [
    { "name": "Brand1", "reputationScore": 8, "sentiment": "Positive - description" },
    { "name": "Brand2", "reputationScore": 6, "sentiment": "Mixed - description" },
    { "name": "Brand3", "reputationScore": 7, "sentiment": "Positive - description" }
  ]
}" }}

options.systemMessage: You are a brand reputation analyst. Analyze news sentiment and provide reputation scores from 1-10. Always respond with valid JSON only, no additional text.
